ayahs.translation: Indeed, We sent the Qur'an down during the Night of Decree.
And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?

ayahs.arabic: لَيْلَةُ ٱلْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
ayahs.arabicIndopak: لَيۡلَةُ الۡقَدۡرِ  ۙ خَيۡرٌ مِّنۡ اَلۡفِ شَهۡرٍؕ‏
ayahs.translation: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.

ayahs.arabic: تَنَزَّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ فِيهَا بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِم مِّن كُلِّ أَمْرٍ
ayahs.arabicIndopak: تَنَزَّلُ الۡمَلٰٓٮِٕكَةُ وَالرُّوۡحُ فِيۡهَا بِاِذۡنِ رَبِّهِمۡ​ۚ مِّنۡ كُلِّ اَمۡرٍ ۛۙ‏
ayahs.transliteration: Tanazzalu-l-malāʾikatu war-rūḥu fīhā biʾidhni rabbihim min kulli amr
ayahs.translation: The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
